# Substack
> The app for independent voices.

Substack is a publishing, subscription, and community platform for writers, podcasters, and creators. It provides tools for newsletters, blogs, podcasts, payments, audience growth, and reader engagement.

## Product
- [Home](https://substack.com/): Main overview of Substack for publishing, subscriptions, and audience building.
- [Go to app](https://substack.com/home): Entry point to the signed-in Substack reader and creator experience.
- [Discover](https://substack.com/discover): Browse publications, writers, podcasts, and topics across the platform.
- [Notes](https://substack.com/notes): Social feed for short-form posts, recommendations, and conversations.
- [Podcasts](https://substack.com/podcasts): Explore podcast publishing and listening on Substack.
- [Bestsellers](https://substack.com/bestsellers): Ranked list of top-performing paid and popular Substack publications.

## For Creators
- [Start writing](https://substack.com/signup): Create a Substack account and begin publishing newsletters or posts.
- [Start publishing](https://substack.com/publish): Launch a publication and configure creator tools.
- [Substack for writers](https://substack.com/for-writers): Overview of writing, publishing, and subscription features for authors.
- [Substack for podcasters](https://substack.com/for-podcasters): Overview of podcast hosting, distribution, and subscriber monetization.
- [Substack Pro](https://substack.com/pro): Program and services for selected creators growing on Substack.
- [Publisher leaderboard](https://substack.com/leaderboard): View leading publications and creator performance across categories.

## Help Center
- [Help Center home](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us): Main support portal for readers, writers, and podcasters.
- [Writers](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002434171-Writers): Help articles for publication setup, posts, payments, and audience management.
- [Readers](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002434191-Readers): Help articles for subscriptions, accounts, email delivery, and app usage.
- [Podcasters](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/categories/4408071704339-Podcasters): Help articles for podcast publishing, feeds, and subscriber access.
- [Using the Substack app](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/sections/4410706449811-Using-the-Substack-app): Guidance for reading, listening, and engaging in the mobile app.
- [Getting started as a writer](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/sections/360011801411-Getting-started-as-a-writer): Introductory setup guides for new Substack publishers.
- [Payments and billing](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/sections/360011801591-Payments-and-billing): Support for paid subscriptions, payouts, and billing issues.

## Writer Guides
- [Substack FAQ for writers](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037832171-Substack-FAQ-for-writers): Core answers about publishing, subscriptions, and platform policies.
- [Getting started on Substack](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037488171-Getting-started-on-Substack): Step-by-step introduction to launching a publication.
- [How to create a post](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037465171-How-do-I-create-a-post-on-Substack): Instructions for drafting and publishing posts.
- [How to import your email list](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037466191-How-do-I-import-my-email-list-to-Substack): Guide to migrating subscribers onto Substack.
- [How to charge for subscriptions](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037832191-How-do-I-charge-for-subscriptions-on-Substack): Explains paid subscriptions and pricing setup.
- [How to customize your publication](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037466211-How-do-I-customize-my-publication-s-look-and-feel): Covers branding and publication appearance settings.

## Reader Guides
- [Substack FAQ for readers](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037488191-Substack-FAQ-for-readers): Core answers about subscriptions, accounts, and reading experience.
- [How to subscribe to a publication](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037466231-How-do-I-subscribe-to-a-publication-on-Substack): Explains free and paid subscription flows.
- [How to manage subscriptions](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037832211-How-do-I-manage-my-subscriptions-on-Substack): Guidance for updating and organizing subscriptions.
- [How to update payment information](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360037466251-How-do-I-update-my-payment-information): Instructions for changing billing details.
- [How to use the Substack app](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/4410706451219-What-is-the-Substack-app): Overview of app features for readers and listeners.
- [How to comment on posts](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/360051222592-How-do-comments-work-on-Substack): Explains commenting and discussion participation.

## Podcasts
- [Podcast help center](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/categories/4408071704339-Podcasters): Central support category for podcasters on Substack.
- [Getting started as a podcaster](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/sections/4408071840531-Getting-started-as-a-podcaster): Setup guides for launching a podcast publication.
- [How to publish podcast episodes](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408071991571-How-do-I-publish-a-podcast-episode-on-Substack): Instructions for uploading and publishing episodes.
- [Private podcast feeds](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408072019091-How-do-private-podcast-feeds-work): Explains subscriber-only podcast feed access.
- [Import a podcast to Substack](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408071980051-How-do-I-import-my-podcast-to-Substack): Guide to migrating an existing podcast.
- [Podcast analytics](https://support.substack.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408072027539-How-do-I-view-podcast-analytics): Overview of podcast performance metrics.
